added_lines: FACEBOOKFacebook.com/tubbercurrycloonacoolTWITTER @tubbercloona A PRAYER FOR OUR PARISH Lord, watch over our parish, encouraging us to watch with one another as we seek to know your will. Make us gentle in word, kind in spirit, strong in hope and guide us, ever gently along that road of peace that leads to your door; a door that will always open to the knock of faithful people. Amen. CHRIST THE KING We are here! Another Church Year concludes today as we celebrate the Feast of Christ The King. The journey has taken us through the Liturgical Seasons of Advent, Christmas, Lent, Easter, Pentecost and what we call Ordinary Time. The constant in it all is our calling to celebrate faith. To celebrate we need to gather and to gather we need to continue to encourage one another. A word of thanks to all who have journeyed with us through this Church Year. Thanks to all who have been involved in parish ministries and to all who support the parish in any way!Why do we do this? Because it is our calling. Once baptized, we become part of God’s family, and we travel a shared road. On that road we offer support to the wearied, prayer for the afflicted and help to carry one another when the road is hard. In all of this, we strive to give glory to Christ The King, who himself has travelled the road before and for us. To Him be glory, now and forever. Amen. Tubbercurry-Cloonacool
